About:

In this video, Drew shares his raw Amazon FBA journey with Travis Marziani, going from a costly private label failure to success by pivoting into niche products and Amazon KDP. With guidance from Travis and the Passion Product Formula, Drew shows why it’s not too late to start selling on Amazon in 2025 and 2026, and how failure can push you toward the right business model and long-term freedom.
• Drew’s real Amazon FBA failure with private label, including his sleep mask product that lost over $10,000
• Why skipping proper product validation, keyword research, and market research causes most new Amazon FBA sellers to fail
• Oversaturation on Amazon, generic private label products, and why “me too” listings struggle to rank and stay profitable
• Fear of failure in entrepreneurship, mindset shifts for Amazon sellers, and how Drew reframed his losses with Travis’s help
• Why Amazon FBA is not dead in 2025 and 2026, and how niche branding and passion products still win
• The difference between chasing trending products vs solving real problems and filling specific gaps in the market
• How Travis built niche brands (like a carnivore electrolyte powder) using passion product and audience-first strategies
• What niche branding means, why specificity beats price competition, and how to stand out against Amazon competitors
• Startup costs for Amazon FBA, Amazon KDP, and niche physical products broken down with real-world numbers from Drew and Travis
• How Drew pivoted into Amazon KDP (Kindle Direct Publishing) with almost no upfront inventory cost
• Selling books, journals, coloring books, and print-on-demand products on Amazon with KDP
• Why Amazon KDP has zero inventory risk, high scalability, and works well alongside or instead of traditional Amazon FBA
• Using keyword research, real demand, and search volume instead of fads, trends, and guesswork
• How Amazon fees impact low-margin generic sellers vs premium niche brands built the Travis “passion product” way
• Organic ranking, keyword optimization, and how some products can launch without heavy PPC ads
• Selling on Amazon during a recession, which product categories hold up, and how niche audiences stay loyal
• Why passion products, niche audiences, and alignment with your interests matter for long-term Amazon success
• Learning from failure, pivoting business models, and finding your true calling as an entrepreneur with guidance from Travis

This video brings together Amazon FBA, Amazon KDP, niche branding, passion products, and real-world entrepreneurship lessons from Drew and Travis Marziani. Whether you’re starting an Amazon business, considering Kindle Direct Publishing, or recovering from a failed product launch, you’ll learn how to validate ideas, reduce risk, avoid oversaturation, and build a sustainable Amazon business the smart way.
